CREATE TABLE public.subscription_retry_obligations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  renewal_operation_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES public.subscription_renewal_operations(id),
  subscription_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.subscriptions(id),
  cycle_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES public.subscription_cycles(id),
  order_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES public.commerce_orders(id),
  settlement_intent_id uuid NOT NULL UNIQUE REFERENCES public.commerce_settlement_intents(id),
  logical_cycle_number integer NOT NULL CHECK (logical_cycle_number > 0),
  identity_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  operation_fingerprint text NOT NULL CHECK (operation_fingerprint ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  scheduled_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  cycle_snapshot jsonb NOT NULL,
  retry_attempt integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (retry_attempt >= 0),
  attempt_sequence integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (attempt_sequence >= 0),
  state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'waiting' CHECK (state IN ('waiting','prepared','recovered')),
  next_retry_at timestamptz,
  failure_class text,
  failure_reason text,
  failed_at timestamptz,
  case_id uuid REFERENCES public.subscription_dunning_cases(id),
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (subscription_id, scheduled_at)
);
CREATE INDEX subscription_retry_due_idx ON public.subscription_retry_obligations(state,next_retry_at,id);

CREATE TABLE public.subscription_retry_receipts (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  obligation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.subscription_retry_obligations(id),
  receipt_key text NOT NULL UNIQUE CHECK (btrim(receipt_key) <> ''),
  kind text NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('failure','prepare','recovery','schedule')),
  attempt_sequence integer NOT NULL CHECK (attempt_sequence >= 0),
  input jsonb NOT NULL,
  result jsonb NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE (obligation_id, kind, attempt_sequence)
);

CREATE TABLE public.subscription_retry_recovery_authorizations (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  obligation_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.subscription_retry_obligations(id),
  token_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.commerce_checkout_recovery_tokens(id),
  retry_attempt integer NOT NULL CHECK (retry_attempt > 0),
  method_ref text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(method_ref) <> ''),
  method_evidence_ref text NOT NULL CHECK (btrim(method_evidence_ref) <> ''),
  authorized_at timestamptz NOT NULL,
  consumed_at timestamptz,
  UNIQUE (token_id, retry_attempt),
  UNIQUE (obligation_id, retry_attempt)
);
REVOKE ALL ON TABLE public.subscription_retry_obligations, public.subscription_retry_receipts, public.subscription_retry_recovery_authorizations FROM PUBLIC, anon, authenticated;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT d.id, min(event.payload ->> 'paymentAttemptId')::uuid AS attempt_id
    FROM public.subscription_dunning_cases d
    JOIN public.subscription_events event
      ON event.subscription_id = d.subscription_id AND event.cycle_id = d.cycle_id
    JOIN public.commerce_payment_attempts attempt
      ON attempt.id::text = event.payload ->> 'paymentAttemptId'
     AND attempt.payment_intent_id = d.payment_intent_id
   WHERE d.status = 'open'
     AND event.event_type IN ('subscription.retry_scheduled', 'subscription.payment_failed')
     AND event.payload ->> 'source' = 'payment.control.v0'
     AND event.payload ->> 'paymentIntentId' = d.payment_intent_id::text
     AND event.payload ->> 'retryAttempt' = d.retry_attempt::text
   GROUP BY d.id HAVING count(DISTINCT attempt.id) = 1
), attributed AS (
  SELECT c.*, receipt.response_payload
    FROM candidates c
    JOIN public.subscription_dunning_cases d ON d.id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
      SELECT k.response_payload FROM public.commerce_idempotency_keys k
       WHERE k.scope = 'subscription.dunning.failure' AND k.status = 'completed'
         AND k.response_payload #>> '{subscriptionDunning,caseId}' = c.id::text
         AND k.response_payload #>> '{subscriptionDunning,retryAttempt}' = d.retry_attempt::text
         AND k.response_payload #>> '{subscriptionDunning,paymentIntentId}' = d.payment_intent_id::text
         AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.subscription_payment_recovery_tokens token
           WHERE token.case_id = d.id AND token.revoked_at IS NULL
             AND token.token_hash = encode(sha256(convert_to(split_part(
               k.response_payload #>> '{subscriptionDunning,recoveryUrlPath}', 'token=', 2), 'UTF8')), 'hex'))
       ORDER BY k.created_at, k.idempotency_key LIMIT 1
    ) receipt ON true
)
UPDATE public.subscription_dunning_cases d
   SET failed_payment_attempt_id = a.attempt_id,
       failure_observation_result = a.response_payload
  FROM attributed a WHERE d.id = a.id;

WITH receipt_attempts AS (
  SELECT receipt.idempotency_key, min(attempt.id::text)::uuid AS attempt_id
    FROM public.commerce_idempotency_keys receipt
    JOIN public.subscription_dunning_cases d
      ON d.id::text = receipt.response_payload #>> '{subscriptionDunning,caseId}'
    JOIN public.subscription_events event
      ON event.subscription_id = d.subscription_id AND event.cycle_id = d.cycle_id
    JOIN public.commerce_payment_attempts attempt
      ON attempt.id::text = event.payload ->> 'paymentAttemptId'
     AND attempt.payment_intent_id::text = receipt.response_payload #>> '{subscriptionDunning,paymentIntentId}'
   WHERE d.status = 'open' AND receipt.scope = 'subscription.dunning.failure' AND receipt.status = 'completed'
     AND event.event_type IN ('subscription.retry_scheduled', 'subscription.payment_failed')
     AND event.payload ->> 'source' = 'payment.control.v0'
     AND event.payload ->> 'paymentIntentId' = receipt.response_payload #>> '{subscriptionDunning,paymentIntentId}'
     AND event.payload ->> 'retryAttempt' = receipt.response_payload #>> '{subscriptionDunning,retryAttempt}'
   GROUP BY receipt.idempotency_key HAVING count(DISTINCT attempt.id) = 1
)
UPDATE public.commerce_idempotency_keys receipt
   SET metadata = receipt.metadata || jsonb_build_object('failedPaymentAttemptId', a.attempt_id)
  FROM receipt_attempts a
 WHERE receipt.scope = 'subscription.dunning.failure' AND receipt.idempotency_key = a.idempotency_key;

    (composition_locked_at IS NOT NULL AND composition_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'));

ALTER TABLE public.sales_channel_connections
  ADD COLUMN control_version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(control_version BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),
  ADD COLUMN application_ref text CHECK(application_ref IS NULL OR btrim(application_ref)<>''),
  ADD COLUMN environment_ref text CHECK(environment_ref IS NULL OR btrim(environment_ref)<>''),
  ADD COLUMN seller_external_ref text CHECK(seller_external_ref IS NULL OR btrim(seller_external_ref)<>'');
ALTER TABLE public.sales_channels ADD COLUMN control_version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(control_version BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991);

ALTER TABLE public.sales_channel_listings ADD COLUMN control_version bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK(control_version BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991),
  ADD COLUMN current_qualification_id uuid, ADD COLUMN current_approval_id uuid, ADD COLUMN manual_stop boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
  ADD COLUMN exposure_issued_units bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN exposure_converted_units bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN exposure_withdrawn_units bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ADD COLUMN exposure_generation bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  ADD COLUMN exposure_issued_basis_ref uuid,
  ADD CONSTRAINT channel_exposure_retained_conservation CHECK(exposure_issued_units BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991
    AND exposure_converted_units BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND exposure_withdrawn_units BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991
    AND exposure_generation BETWEEN 0 AND 9007199254740991 AND exposure_converted_units::numeric+exposure_withdrawn_units<=exposure_issued_units);

CREATE TABLE public.sales_channel_control_operations (
  resource_kind text NOT NULL CHECK(resource_kind IN ('connection','channel','listing')), resource_id uuid NOT NULL,
  operation text NOT NULL CHECK(operation IN ('registry_apply','listing_prepare','listing_record_qualification','listing_approve',
    'listing_manual_stop','exposure_allocate','exposure_convert_sale','exposure_reclaim_unsold')),
  operation_id uuid NOT NULL, actor_id uuid NOT NULL, input_digest text NOT NULL CHECK(input_digest ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'),
  canonical_text text NOT NULL CHECK(octet_length(canonical_text) BETWEEN 2 AND 262144), result jsonb NOT NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), PRIMARY KEY(resource_kind,resource_id,operation,operation_id));

  body jsonb NOT NULL, created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT clock_timestamp(), UNIQUE(id,listing_id), UNIQUE(listing_id,listing_version));
